title: Loop Angle Declaration Evidence
description: REQ-003 FR-001: pre-review evidence type written by angle-declaration skill before review_team_dispatch. Carries the reviewer's declared angles for this round (declared_angles[]) plus dispositions for every inherited active angle from team-manifest.inherited_angles (dispositions[]). Schema enforcement rejects empty/generic targets (angle target blacklist delegated to runtime.ValidateAngleTarget). The guard angle_complete_guard (TASK-003-C) uses this evidence type as fail-closed precondition for DV/QA/E2E phase transitions.

evidence_id.description: Stable id used in runtime.evidence[].id; pattern matches other evidence types.

dimension.description: Which verification phase this declaration belongs to. Maps 1:1 to the three angle_complete guards.

declared_at.description: When the reviewer drafted this declaration. Must be <= committed_at.

committed_at.description: When this evidence was written to disk. The angle_declared_before_dispatch guard compares this against team-manifest.dispatched_at.

declared_angles.description: Non-empty when manifest.min_angles > 0 (default 3, E2E NA path min 1, N=0 only when E2E+ui_impact=none and manifest explicitly sets min_angles=0).

dispositions.description: Required to cover every team-manifest.inherited_angles entry 1:1 (modulo Q-010 batch_confirm allowance for adjacent modules). May be empty when inherited_angles is empty (first round of a new module).

id.description: Round-local id (not the registry id). Used to cross-reference dispositions within this declaration.

target.description: Concrete target. Blacklisted words (security/performance/correctness/reliability/safety/usability/maintainability/testability) rejected by runtime.ValidateAngleTarget at commit time.

kind.description: batch_confirm allowed only for adjacent modules (Q-010); must list affected angle_ids in note.

note.description: Mandatory: retract requires reason, extend requires new angle target, batch_confirm requires shared rationale and angle_id list.
